subsection.title: Solution Strategy
subsection.description: - In one concise sketch, explain the product-level approach and the minimum user-visible capabilities, moments, and information needed to try it. - Include a permission, privacy, safety, limit, or failure rule only when the PoC itself must honor it. - Do not assign Feature IDs or add implementation detail.

subsection.title: Core User Flow
subsection.description: - Default to one core flow for the confirmed Primary Persona. - State the starting context, sequential user actions, visible product responses, and observable completion result. - Add another flow only when the core hypothesis cannot be exercised without it. - Keep only the behavior needed by the first PoC.
subsection.example:
**Core user flow: Practice a difficult expression**
| Step | Primary Persona action | Visible product response | Completion evidence | |------|------------------------|--------------------------|---------------------| | 1 | Enters an English expression | Creates practice questions about that expression | Focused practice is ready | | 2 | Answers the generated questions | Shows the result and saves the expression | The learner sees what needs more practice | | 3 | Opens the expression list | Shows the saved expression for another practice round | The learner can continue later |
**Completion result:** The learner can solve expression-specific questions and find the expression again.
